articles.author: SOAR AI, Inc.
articles.headline: Volato Group Signs Definitive Agreement for $500 Million AI Infrastructure Merger with Alignment Engine
articles.summary: Volato announced an agreement to merge with Alignment Engine at an approximately $500 million valuation. The stated value and future capacity roadmap are not cash proceeds or completed merger capacity.
articles.timestampEvidence: Full BusinessWire syndication FinancialContent explicitly August 26 08:00 AM EDT.

articles.author: Volato Group
articles.headline: Volato Group's Alignment Engine Subsidiary Signs $1.2 Billion in AI Infrastructure Orders with Large AI Customer
articles.summary: Volato's Alignment Engine announces two four-year take-or-pay orders with $1.17 billion aggregate contractual value and approximately $133 million scheduled prepayments. Deployment, acceptance and performance conditions remain; the headline contract value is not cash collected or revenue recognized at entry.
articles.timestampEvidence: Business Wire syndications at FinancialContent and StreetInsider explicitly identify September 28, 2026 at 08:05 AM EDT.
